subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should authenticated plugin pages extend the existing `registerControlUiDescriptor` tab contract, or should OpenClaw permanently support a second `registerControlUiEntryPoint` navigation API?
rationale: This selects a durable public plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, routing, and security boundary; automation cannot safely choose whether the established descriptor contract should be evolved or supplemented.

options.title: Extend existing descriptors
options.body: Fold scoped launch/session authentication into the existing descriptor-backed tab path and remove the parallel entry-point API.

options.title: Approve both contracts
options.body: Keep the new app-navigation API but explicitly define how it differs from descriptor tabs, including compatibility, migration, client support, and security ownership.

options.title: Pause for UI API RFC
options.body: Hold or close this implementation until the related Control UI contribution proposals establish one canonical plugin UI model.

recommendation.title: Extend existing descriptors
recommendation.body: Fold scoped launch/session authentication into the existing descriptor-backed tab path and remove the parallel entry-point API.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Control UI plugin-management proposal defines the surrounding route and plugin-panel product boundary.
